# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, so a 25W bank charges it faster than the 15W ones. The trade-off is that the slimmest banks are 5,000mAh with slower wireless speeds.

## My picks

**Best slim 5K overall: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with Qi2 15W wireless and 20W wired charging. Anker lists it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than competitors.
- 5K gets you roughly 60-75% of a charge, per Macworld.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Best slim 10K with 25W: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It's 0.5" thick and 195g, with 45W wired output and a built-in lanyard-style cable.
- Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K bank. Android Central praises the value, at $42.99 on Amazon or $44.99 at INIU.
- This is the best choice if you want a full recharge and fast wireless speed without much bulk.
- [Android Central review, with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104g, and Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the group.
- Its wireless speed is only 7.5W, which is slow for an iPhone 17. Pick it only if size matters more than speed.
- [Android Central review, with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Tougher option: TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K), about $70-80**
- It's 0.57" thick and 195g, with 15W wireless and IP54 dust and water resistance, which is unusual for a Qi2 bank.
- [Android Central review, with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

## One more option
The **Baseus PicoGo AM52** (10K, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired) is $53.99 with code AM52, which the deal site says it tested in Baseus's cart on 2026-10-24. The listing doesn't give its thickness, so I can't vouch that it's slim. This is an affiliate link, and the store's checkout has the final word on price: [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)

## Bottom line
- **Pocketable:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **Best balance of slimness, capacity and speed:** INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
